summary: City page: RV hookup sites ($20 E/W, $25 full), bathhouse, WiFi, dump, closed ~Nov 1-Mar 1, and RESERVATION ONLY by phone, which contradicts the stored FCFS (derived; replaced). Fees added. Monthly rates on all 31 sites: long-stay character check flagged. Electric amps not stated (50 left as derived). Waterfront not waterfront kept, with a lead up.
flags: LONG-STAY CHECK (human decides): the city posts monthly rates for every full-hookup site ('$550 - Monthly rate; Full Hookups Sites 1-14', '$450 - Monthly Rate; Full Hookups Site 15-31'), and the stored note said reservations were once dropped 'due to many long-term campers'. Against that, it posts nightly RV rates ($20/$25) and is a city park with tent sites and day use. Google 4.6 from 85. I'd call it a transient-capable city park and keep it, but whether nightly sites are actually available to a traveller is untested (the city says 'Always call ahead and check availability').

FEES: the page carries no year; it's the live operator page, read 2026-11-05, and matches Wayback's July 2026 captures. The old note's '$20 full/$15 electric' is outdated ($25 / $20 now). Base = $20 E/W site.

From imagery the camping loop's nearest leg is ~20-40 m from the channel behind riverside trees; I can't place sites, so no upgrade. riverview is plausible if official photos show a view.
